comments.endpoint: GET /api/web/v1/spaces/<net>/posts/<pid>/comments returns ROOT comments only, each with reply_count + a TRUNCATED latest_replies preview (a 4-reply thread ships 1). Full replies come from the same endpoint with ?reply_to_id=<comment_id> - there is no /comments/<id>/replies route (404).

media.note: Downloaded to resources/images/. imgix query params stripped so the original asset is kept, not a resize.

gaps: Quiz/exam QUESTIONS not harvested: /spaces/<net>/posts/<id>/quiz_questions returns 403 (route exists, access denied) until a quiz ATTEMPT is started. Starting 76 attempts would write to the account's course progress, gamification and leaderboard. Not done without an explicit go-ahead.

VIDEOS (123, all community - The Pit 100, Welcome 23; ZERO curriculum videos) not downloaded. The post record carries only a thumbnail; media2-production.mightynetworks.com/asset/<uuid>/<name> returns 403 for every unsigned path, so playback needs a signed URL the app issues at play time. The player also does not mount on /posts/<id> (no <video> element, empty iframe), so the stream URL never appears in a page probe.

harvest_notes.content_tree_api: GET /api/web/v1/spaces/<space_id>/content returns full module/lesson tree (thin records: title, slug, description-preview, image_url, prompt_type). Verified working on the-mastery.
harvest_notes.body_text: Lesson BODY hangs off the NETWORK space id, not the course space id: GET /api/web/v1/spaces/23776511/posts/<post_id>. Using the course space id returns the thin stub; /api/web/v1/posts/<id> is a 404. Confirmed 2026-08-17.
harvest_notes.is_thin_flag: 'is_thin': true on a post record is Mighty's ACCESS flag, not a compression option. Anonymous callers always get is_thin:true with no body field. Same url returns the body once a session exists. If harvested posts come back thin, the session lapsed - re-run --harvest, it skips files already on disk.
harvest_notes.auth: BU SSO (Google OAuth -> BU Shibboleth -> Duo 2FA). The auth cookie is a SESSION cookie: it does NOT survive closing the browser, even with a persistent profile. So login + discover + harvest must all run in ONE process invocation (tools/mighty_harvest.py --discover --harvest). Persistent profile still beats storage_state for Cloudflare clearance.
harvest_notes.auth_detection: ONLY /api/web/v1/users/current distinguishes anon from authed (401/403 anon, 200 authed). Since the creator made the curriculum free, /content, /role_map, /current_user/progress and /spaces/<net>/posts/<id> ALL return 200 to anonymous visitors - any login check built on those is a false positive. That bug is what made the 2026-08-12 attempt 'succeed' at login and then scrape an empty logged-out page.
harvest_notes.not_bot_detection: The 2026-08-12 conclusion 'Cloudflare blocks the scrape' was wrong. The probe captured 15/15 API responses at HTTP 200. Two real causes: (a) the false-positive auth check above, (b) DOM scraping instead of asking the API. Issue every API call with fetch() from INSIDE the authenticated page (page.evaluate) - it inherits the SPA's cookies/referer/Sec-Fetch headers and is indistinguishable from the app. Caveat: in-page fetch is same-origin, so it throws 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' whenever the page is away at the SSO provider - wait for the page to be back on *.mn.co before calling.

exam_questions.answer_key: every question has choices[].is_correct (all single-answer); rendered into each exam's lesson.md with the correct choice marked
exam_questions.method: Each question is its own post: a quiz record's quiz_question_ids are post ids, and GET /api/web/v1/spaces/<net>/posts/<qid> returns the full record. The course is public, so this works anonymously over plain HTTP (mighty_harvest.py --quizzes --http, no browser). /quiz_questions still 403s without an attempt - not used.

video_transcripts.method: Mighty auto-captions every upload (Deepgram): GET /videos/<asset_id>/captions returns an HLS subtitle playlist with a CloudFront-signed VTT URL. The one Vimeo embed (START HERE) via yt-dlp --write-subs --sub-langs en-x-autogen --skip-download on player.vimeo.com. No media kept - PC is short on disk and RAM.
video_transcripts.note: The 2026-08-17 conclusion 'videos not downloadable' was wrong: the post record has assets[] with the asset id, and the caption route is same-origin.
